Independent integer 11-slot cyclic-exponent summation over all 121 pairs
Primary Li v1/v2 mathematical definitions
correctness.rationale: For p=11, the fixed R={0,1,2,3,4,5,7} has seven distinct elements. Each displayed length-10 integer row is nonzero; because Phi_11(t)=1+t+...+t^10 is the irreducible minimal polynomial of a primitive 11th root and has degree 10, each row represents a nonzero c_x in Z[zeta], so support is exactly seven. For every (a,b) in F_11^2 the polynomial P_{a,b}(t)=sum_x D_x(t)t^((a*x*x+b*x) mod 11) satisfies F(a,b)=P_{a,b}(zeta); F vanishes iff the remainder modulo Phi_11 is zero. Independently recomputed all 121 values WITHOUT running the submitted checker, accumulating integer coefficients by cyclic exponent shift in an 11-component vector and testing whether all 11 components were equal (the unique cyclotomic relation). Found exactly (0,4),(1,0),(1,1),(1,9),(6,6),(6,7),(6,9),(7,3),(9,9), and 112 nonzeros; for example remainder at (0,0) is (11,11,11,11,0,11,33,0,11,22), nonzero. The source verifier implements another exact 10-dimensional quotient algorithm, not a numerical floating-point approximation; checked its transformations but independently implemented a different test. This proves only the finite existence/lower bound M_{11}(7)>=9 for exact size 7; not optimality, a global 9-zero upper bound, or other primes.
residual_risks: The submitted computation gives a single witness and does not certify an exhaustive search over all possible supports or the global exact maximum.
No correctness claim is made for the v1 upper bound ten; it is context, not a premise of this witness.

evidence: Li v1 Theorem 4.13 gives only the universal upper bound |Z|<=10 for exact support 7 and p>=11, with no nine-zero existence assertion; Remark 4.15 says sharpness at p=11 remains unknown.
Li v2 Theorem 1.2 gives |Z|<=p+2 floor(k/2)-2, hence <=15 when p=11,k=7, and Corollary 6.6 concerns even-support equality families.
Fiorentino–Weigert 2022 treats aggregate complete-MUB support and reports numerical non-saturation for primes through 19; inspected Section 4.4 does not assert an exact seven-support nine-zero state.
broader_coverage.reasoning: A bound from above cannot imply that a specified lower witness exists. General complete-MUB global optimizers or even-support constructions do not imply the odd exact-seven-support nine-zero instance. Earlier numerical nonexistence of states saturating a much stronger aggregate bound is compatible with this modest nine-zero construction.

originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge originality attaches to the explicit full-seven-support nine-zero coefficient witness over F_11, not the cyclotomic Fourier evaluation method or original source upper bounds. Independently recomputed the claim and compared the exact formula/implications with materially inspected Li v1 Section 4.1 (seven-support <=10, p=11 sharpness open), Li v2 (different weaker general odd upper estimate/global MUB), and Fiorentino–Weigert 2022 Section 4.4 (aggregate MUB non-saturation, not this construction). Three fresh Resultary semantic searches and targeted external searches returned the same assigned Resultary mirror but no separately sourced equivalent or stronger existence theorem. The five-support F_11 six-zero example is insufficient since exact seven support requires two additional nonzero coefficients. The upper bound ten does not give lower bound nine. This is a limited priority conclusion, not proof no other nine-zero witness exists.

value.rationale: The exact-support k=7, p=11 finite-parabola maximum is a natural unresolved numerical invariant explicitly identified by Li v1 Remark 4.15. A full-support nine-zero example is an exact self-contained lower-bound witness, not an arbitrary coordinate table for its own sake: it narrows the open candidate maximum from a generic 6-equation lower baseline to at least nine, and, conditional on the v1 bound <=10, confines it to nine or ten. It also translates to a seven-component state with nine forbidden outcomes in the standard quadratic MUB family. Full exhaustive 121-point integer evaluation certifies the specific fact independently of any unfinished global census; no general theorem or paper-sized contribution is required for this motivated finite invariant. It does not claim maximum nine, uniqueness, full support census, or extension to other fields.
residual_risks: Only a lower-bound witness; proving whether ten is attainable remains open here.
The near-upper-bound interpretation relies on Li v1 Theorem 4.13 and must be qualified because v2 omitted that refinement.
An explicit bulky seven-coefficient instance without a broader structural explanation has narrower value than a full classification, although it settles a precise unknown existence question.
